`final class FixedMatrixImport`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.state` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [FixedMatrixImport.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/state/FixedMatrixImport.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

Loads the projection and modelview matrices of the fixed pipeline of a compatibility host into the matrix stacks of JOID.

- [Import the matrices of a fixed-function host](/build/embedding-in-a-host/#import-the-matrices-of-a-fixed-function-host)

## Creation details

<a id="FixedMatrixImport-factory-create"></a>

### create

`FixedMatrixImport create(GlRenderBridge bridge)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: Only a compatibility context has fixed-function matrices to import, this context is … with …: create the context with the compatibility profile to import them

Creates the import for the bridge.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when the context is not a compatibility context, which has no fixed-function matrices.
